props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting tags when the component manages its own state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full tag list after every change.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown while there are no tags.

props.name: max
props.description: Most tags allowed. Further input is ignored.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Allow the same tag twice. Off by default.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Words offered under the field. Clicking one adds it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops all interaction and dims the field.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the field for screen readers when there is no visible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
